text:
nora: Quick post-meeting capture for the Orchestrix integration —— they want a modular connector into our gateway and a small reference app in their marketplace.
sam: sounds good. are we doing a hosted adapter first or open-source connector?
nora: agreed to start with a hosted adapter (Orchestrix runs the control plane) then open-source the adapter if partner ok. keeps onboarding fast.
diego: tech bits: need a health-check endpoint, model capability discovery handshake (they support streaming & tool-calls), and a rate-limit mapping. sketch: 
```
adapter:
  name: orchestrix-connector
  handshake:
    discover_url: https://orchestrix.example.io/_discover
    supports: [streaming, tool_calls]
  auth: oauth2_client_credentials
  rate_limit_mapping:
    orchestrix: 100rps
    redwood_route: 60rps
```
partner-bot: Orchestrix partner intake: https://partners.example.com/flows/ORCH-22  
 contact: tech@orchestrix.io  
 status: intake-complete.
amy: GTM note: they prefer a co-branded webinar instead of a blog first. can we do a tech demo in 8 weeks?
nora: engineering timeline: 6 weeks for MVP adapter + 1 week for integration testing. 8 weeks demo is doable.
sam: tests: nonce-based token rotation for the adapter, automated smoke test against our sandbox route, and a canary rollout. who owns the canary?
diego: I'll own canary + discovery tests. will add a Prometheus exporter for adapter metrics.
amy: marketing will need 2 screenshots, a bullet list of supported workflows, and a joint demo script. i'm making a checklist.
partner-bot: NDA status: pending signature from Orchestrix legal. Reminder to not publish assets until NDA signed.
nora: risk note: Orchestrix uses a proprietary batching layer that may conflict with our prefix caching. we'll need to test cache-coherency under concurrent requests.
sam: good call. velocity tradeoff: if proprietary batching causes regressions we might opt for a compatibility mode (disable prefix cache for that route).
diego: will prototype compatibility mode in the PR. also will surface metrics for token-inflight and cache hit-rate.
amy: GTM constraint: webinar date tentatively set for 2026-05-14. can we confirm by 2 weeks?
nora: yes. owners: diego -> prototype + metrics, sam -> auth/token flow + feature flag, amy -> webinar script & assets, nora -> integration spec + partner comms.
sam: feature flag name: `orchestrix_connector_v1` with rollout to internal accounts first.
partner-bot: Partner workspace updated: ORCH-22 assigned to nora.
amy: adding reminder to schedule a dry-run with partner presenters 1 week before webinar.
diego: starting PR tomorrow, will link sandbox route and test harness.
nora: thanks everyone. reply here with PR link or blocker updates.
